plan.title: Order Activity on Live RFQ with Two Bids

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with two bids on its summary page.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled as required by the case configuration.
Assert that Order Activity is present and clickable in the RFQ Settings menu.
Click Order Activity from the RFQ Settings menu.
Assert that the Activity drawer or window opened.
Close the Activity window without confirming or changing anything.
